meta.title: LingoLinq Launch Readiness Requirements
meta.description: Strategy-layer requirement matrix for the Compliance & Launch Readiness dashboard. Encodes the direct requirements for each launch milestone. This file NEVER overrides audit-reports/FINDINGS.json, which remains canonical for finding lifecycle (status, severity, disposition, closure evidence).
meta.governance: Only Scot ratifies this matrix, changes humanStatus governance semantics, marks a requirement accepted-for-milestone, or flips meta.ratification. Scripts and agents may propose edits via PR but never self-ratify. accepted-risk or disposition=accepted in the findings register NEVER implies accepted-for-milestone here.

ratification.note: RATIFIED at the matrix level: all 40 direct requirement rows carry a complete per-row ratification object (status/ratifiedBy/ratifiedDate), completed across five milestone-by-milestone passes (Adult Beta 2026-08-11, School Beta 2026-08-13, Public MVP 2026-08-13, District Ready 2026-08-14, Long-Term Assurance 2026-08-15) via explicit PR #792 draft-review instructions. This flip is a hard-fail-gated fact, not an assertion: scripts/readiness-check.rb refuses status=ratified unless every row's ratification object is present and complete (status=ratified, non-empty ratifiedBy, ISO ratifiedDate) - see scripts/tests/readiness-check-test.sh 'matrix flipped to ratified with unratified rows fails'. This record is the artifact of Scot's explicit governance approval, not a GitHub-authenticated approval: staging branch protection currently requires no approving reviews and no code-owner review (verified 2026-08-12 via `gh api .../branches/staging/protection` and `gh api .../rules/branches/staging`), so the CODEOWNERS entry on this path is a review-routing convention, not an enforced approval boundary. Ratifying the requirement matrix does NOT decide any of the 7 LAUNCH-PROFILE.json launch-configuration decisions (aiWordPredictionEnabled, aiFocusWordsEnabled, aiBoardGenerationEnabled, euUsersIncluded, minorsIncluded, schoolManagedAccounts, mvpIncludesMinors), which remain undecided and require their own separate deliberate pass.

meta.appliesWhenSemantics: appliesWhen.condition is a tri-state boolean tree over LAUNCH-PROFILE.json decisions. A leaf is a decision key string; interior nodes are {"allOf": [...]} or {"anyOf": [...]}. Kleene evaluation: anyOf is true if any operand is true and false only if all are false; allOf is false if any operand is false and true only if all are true; anything else is undecided. Omitted condition = always applies. An undecided result renders decision-needed (conservative), never blocked or not-required. The earlier flat any-of appliesWhen.decisions form is retired and rejected by the validator. appliesWhen.summary is the human-readable condition.
meta.findingSemantics: findingIds must exist in audit-reports/FINDINGS.json (validated; read-only cross-reference). findingScope is a prose description of an aggregate finding class (e.g. launch-relevant WCAG Mediums) that cannot be pinned to specific IDs. Invariants compute over FINDINGS.json each generation and never store completion status.

Current launch resources should prioritize fixing known security/privacy/accessibility issues and maintaining the real preventive controls already in place, not a dated pentest commitment this stage cannot yet fund.
